title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Jira unreachable; used local rfe-snapshot.md (first 298 of 388 lines reviewed: Business Need, Strategy, ACs, risks).
Scope follows the Strategy: image and audio input only, text output. Audio output, microphone capture, PDF, video, and multiple files per conversation are out of scope and not prototyped.
Audio is transcribed by a user-selected ASR AI Asset before reaching the chat model; prototype shows the transcript step in the transcript.
10 MB file limit is the proposed default pending PM confirmation.
The ASR flag UX on the AI Asset Endpoints table (row action plus confirm dialog, Capability label) is a proposal; the Strategy lists it as needing design.
Model names and capability tags (image-inferencing, audio-asr) are mock data; tag names are still pending agreement.
Prototype is mock-only: no network calls, replies are canned.
